changesets.summary: `slopper login` signs in from the browser
changesets.details: With no token, `slopper login` opens slopper.day on a one-time code. Check it matches the terminal, click Approve, and the CLI collects an API token of its own, named after the machine (logging in again replaces it). `--no-browser` prints the link instead, for a machine without one. `--token` and a piped token still work as before.

changesets.summary: Sign the CLI in without copying a token
changesets.details: Run `npx -y @slopperday/cli login` and it opens Slopper on a one-time code. Check it matches your terminal and approve it, and the CLI gets a token of its own, which you can revoke in Settings like any other. It works from a remote machine too: open the link it prints anywhere you're signed in.

Grouped release for `cli`.

Check it matches the terminal, click Approve, and the CLI collects an API token of its own, named after the machine (logging in again replaces it). `--no-browser` prints the link instead, for a machine without one. `--token` and a piped token still work as before.
